units.source_text: 我的脚所引向的地方，理应有有为子在阳。

en.t: Where my feet were leading me, Uiko ought to have been there in the light.

units.source_text: 十字路口的拐角处有一家叫"大泷"的青楼。

en.t: At the corner of the crossroads there was a brothel called "Otaki."

units.source_text: 我莽撞地钻进了这家的门帘。

en.t: Recklessly, I slipped through the entrance curtain of that house.

units.source_text: 进门就是一间六铺席宽的铺花砖的房间，里首的椅子上坐着三个女人，简直像是等火车等得厌烦的样子。

en.t: Just inside was a room about six tatami mats wide, floored with patterned tiles; on chairs at the back sat three women, looking exactly as if they had grown tired of waiting for a train.

units.source_text: 其中一人身穿和服，脖颈缠着绷带。

en.t: One of them wore a kimono and had a bandage wrapped around her neck.

units.source_text: 另一人身穿西服，低头脱掉袜子，一个劲地搔腿肚子。

en.t: Another, dressed in Western clothes, bent her head to take off her stockings and kept scratching her calves.
Because she was absent, I felt relieved.
